entries.full_claim: Replacing the common conditional mean in each bounded predictable-plug-in factor by its time-specific conditional mean preserves the one-step supermartingale inequality; a constant component bet makes the linear sum target the unweighted average conditional mean.
entries.domain: Finite adapted [0,1]-valued observations, predictable [0,1] predictors and one constant lambda in (0,1).
all_premises: one lambda in (0,1) is used for every confirmatory i
entries.proof_or_source: Frozen_Bounded_Martingale_Coverage_v0_1.md §§2-4; algebraic specialization of the Waudby-Smith–Ramdas Theorem 2 one-step proof.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Varying lambda_i with unequal mu_i yields a weighted target. General dependence makes the average conditional mean potentially random.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Copy/swap: changing bet weights while keeping observations can change the inferred target.

entries.full_claim: The displayed R164 intervals cover all m average conditional means simultaneously with probability at least 1-alpha; under independent participant vectors these are the exact R163 finite-design means and independent pilot selection transports the guarantee planwise.
entries.domain: Fixed finite N,m, bounded W, constant pilot-frozen component bets, predictable predictors, frozen procedure and participant independence for the fixed-target specialization.
all_premises: two tail allocations per component and union over m components
confirmatory participant vectors are independent when identifying theta_N
pilot and confirmation samples are independent
no same-confirmatory-data interval-family or target selection
entries.proof_or_source: Frozen_Bounded_Martingale_Coverage_v0_1.md §§4-5; nonnegative supermartingale, fixed-time Markov bound, two-tail/m-component union bound and R162 tower argument.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Can be wider than Hoeffding; dependence or adaptive method search invalidates the stated finite-design route.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Human-realized agent: coordinated participant records test the independence premise.

entries.full_claim: Under the R163 rare-spike product law, coordinatewise procedures that exclude zero on an all-no-spike component have simultaneous coverage at most (1-.95^N)^m; at N=36,m=8 this is 0.2531673184308581 and controlling that event alone at alpha=.05 requires N>=99.
entries.domain: Explicit independent m-component two-point law and procedures with the stated no-spike failure property.
all_premises: P(W=-1/19)=.95 and P(W=1)=.05 independently across observations and components
the component interval excludes zero on the all-low sample
simultaneous success requires success in every component
entries.proof_or_source: Frozen_Bounded_Martingale_Coverage_v0_1.md §7 and EXACT_CHECKS.json; exact product-event probability and logarithmic threshold calculation.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Not a sufficient N theorem and not a minimax theorem for procedures without the stated coordinatewise failure property.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Abacus/calculator: apparently stable outputs can hide rare deviations; zero empirical variance is not certainty.

entries.full_claim: R164 intervals for all 2m R163 support endpoints simultaneously cover the all-enrollee finite-design means while leaving the pointwise identification width 2(1-bar R_j) unchanged.
entries.domain: Well-defined bounded would-be outcomes, arbitrary observation indicators, independent participant records for the fixed target, and frozen endpoint procedures.
all_premises: all endpoint variables meet R164-P2 premises
would-be Y_ij exists even when unobserved
entries.proof_or_source: Frozen_Bounded_Martingale_Coverage_v0_1.md §8; endpoint coverage, union bound and expectation monotonicity.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Does not apply to physically undefined post-abort outcomes and cannot shrink the support identification width.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Copy/swap/memory: deleting high outcomes changes observation pattern and identification width without changing the recorded support.
